title: Set up your environment
comment: Generic default plan — what nearly everyone needs to run Claude. Pure data, no logic. The engine reads this, runs each `install` in a pty, and shows it. `detect` is how the engine knows a step is already done. a corporate network-specific steps never live here — they arrive as a plugin recipe.

steps.name: Node.js
steps.description: JavaScript runtime — required by Claude Code (and by this tool itself)
steps._selfHost: The panel itself runs ON node. Uninstalling it from inside the panel's own pty would kill the server mid-op (node.exe locked). So a selfHost uninstall runs in a DETACHED window and the server shuts down first to release node.exe.
